rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Drac de Beaucaire, the fearsome dragon of the Rhône shown in its documented lizard form.
ANATOMY: one living lizard-shaped dragon with one head, two eyes, four reptile legs and one long tail, no wings, no horns [drac-de-beaucaire-c14]
MOMENT: surge head-first out of the river toward the viewer, four feet gripping submerged stone, open jaw cutting through falling river water
POWER: river water thrown physically by its emergence, without magical beams or invisibility effect [drac-de-beaucaire-c04]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; tight foreshortened close framing; no invented giant scale or human comparator
LIGHT & WEATHER: one amber dusk source, rim light on water spray; dark walnut and antique gold
SURFACE: wet coarse lizard scales and river mud
SETTING: the bank and shallows of the Rhône at Beaucaire [drac-de-beaucaire-c04, drac-de-beaucaire-c10]
MOOD: menacing / awe-inspiring; dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons; no tattoos, glyphs or pseudo-text.
depicted_variant: Lizard-form Rhône dragon erupting through river water.

visual_requirements.description: Living lizard form documented on Rhône washing-beetles; no speculative wings or horns.
Dragon emerges from Rhône depths, displacing river water physically.

aura: Fearsome emergence c04 and lizard-form anatomy c14 provide menace without invented power.
artistic_choices: Lizard depiction c14 selected over undocumented detailed dragon anatomy; shown alive rather than carving.
Close framing establishes menace without claiming giant dimensions.
Dusk, wet texture, stone and palette are editorial; spray is physical movement, not a new magical power.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px reviewed: all seven Sangar checks yes. Subject dominates with confrontational river emergence, threatening open jaw at 200px, one lizard head/two eyes/four-leg body and single tail, no wings or horns. Water displacement c04; lizard form c14. No magic, text, glyphs, watermark, franchise likeness, gore or nudity.

root_visual_review.notes: Lizard-form dragon bursting out of the Rhône with water pouring off its jaws, Beaucaire's castle on the bank behind [c04, c10, c14]; no wings or horns.
